name: Shizuku
source:
[url=/c8377]Mio[/url]'s childhood friend. Most of the time quite timid and calm girl she could be quite stubborn than it comes to necessary things. She is good at cooking and very emphatic.

[spoiler]She lost her trust in the people in past. She was the part of small sect but other members threated her badly because of Shizu's foreign look. Mother protected her from bullying but after her death situation worsened and Shizu had to run away. Shizuku was a loner till she met Mio.[/spoiler]
